leaves.name: carayolThmA
leaves.doc: Carayol 1986, Theoreme (A), at F = Q, weight 2, packaged printed form over K_{f,lambda} (r17-print): for a printed newform f (Tau Ceti Newform N 2) with number field K_f and a place lambda | l of K_f, there is a continuous, absolutely irreducible (Burnside form) rho : G_Q -> GL_2(K_{f,lambda}) (Mathlib adicCompletion), unramified at p not dividing N l with arithmetic-Frobenius trace a_p(f), whose Serre-Tate conductor exponent at every prime p != l is v_p(N). The passage to r17 (IsNewform = printed newform, extension of scalars to Qbar_l, absolute irreducibility gives semisimplicity, conductor invariance under scalar extension and isomorphism, Brauer-Nesbitt with Chebotarev) is proved in Lean. Replaces r17.
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Carayol 1986 Theoreme (A) for F = Q, weight 2, in the packaging 'rho_{f,lambda} is irreducible, has Frobenius traces a_p and conductor N away from l', as quoted e.g. in Darmon-Diamond-Taylor 1997 Thm 3.1, with irreducibility from Ribet 1977 Thm 2.3); reading risk: Carayol's own Theoreme (A) is local-global compatibility through pi_p, from which the conductor clause follows with Casselman 1973, so the check should confirm that the conductor packaging and absolute irreducibility are printed for rho_{f,lambda}; locators UNVERIFIED
